search.snippet: The teasing stick is a tool used in the Hunter skill. It can be used to flush rabbits for rabbit snaring beginning at level 27, or used to anger animals for pitfall trapping beginning at level 31. The Teasing stick is used to make the desired monster of the hunting variety angry at you. Available at level 31 Hunter, and is used for Pit traps. This tool is required to catch Spined larupia, Horned graahk and Sabre-toothed kyatt. It can be purchased from Aleck's Hunter Emporium in Yanille or... While carrying the teasing stick, players are able to "tease" these animals. Teasing stick is a members-only item with a 4-hour buy limit of 40 and a high alchemy value of 30 coins.
